newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares drop but market healthy - brokers.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares drop but market healthy - brokers.

text.p: Egyptian share prices retreated on Thursday in brisk trade swollen up by the government's sale of another tranche in tobacco monopoly Eastern Company.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) all-share index shed 0.94 points to close at 399.32 against 400.26 points on Wednesday. Turnover was 467.2 million pounds ($137.6 million).
"It is a very healthy market. There is supply, there is demand -- it has depth," said broker Dalia Sultan at EFG/Hermes.

Eastern went up only 0.24 pounds to end at 100, after the state sold about 3.5 million shares or 14 percent of the monopoly cigarette manufacturer in the second stage of the partial privatisation of the company.

The sales, to big investors willing to buy at least 10,000 shares, went through the stock exchange at prices between 96 and 102 pounds a share. The minimum bid price was set at 96 and most bids were in the range 96 to 98 pounds.
Paints and Chemical Industries/PACHIN was heavily traded but the share ended 3.00 pounds down. Shares worth 20.28 million pounds changed hands.
"We are used to Pachin's high volume during the day before ending down," Sultan said, adding there was no clear reason for its sharp turnover surges.
Amriyah Cement, one of the best performing cement firms, rose fractionally 0.15 pounds to end at 85.00 pounds.
"It's a very good share. It is still holding despite high sales recently," Sultan said.

Blue chip banks return to their strong performance after a correction that lasted a few days. Misr International Bank/MIBANK, which will offer GDRs soon, ended 35.00 pounds up at 800.00. "This jump is attributed to the news about the GDRs," said Sultan.
Commercial International Bank also rose 15.11 to 891.01 pounds.
The index for openly traded firms fell to 651.23 from 655.15 points on Wednesday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms was also up, at 267.15 from 267.14.
Out of the 86 shares traded, 34 gained, 33 lost and 19 ended the day unchanged.
